subject: CPool<T> architecture, slot counts for all 13 pools, and memory budget
discovery_note: All slot counts proven cold from CPools::Initialise CREATE phase at 0x5503A0. Each pool's count is a push-imm32 immediately before a typed CPool constructor call. Strides proven from the IMUL in each constructor body. No external project data used.

fields.name: m_pObjects
fields.note: Pointer to element array. malloc(count * element_stride).

fields.name: m_byteMap
fields.note: Parallel flag array. 1 byte per slot. Bit7=isFree, bits6-0=allocation counter.

fields.name: m_nSize
fields.note: Slot count. Written once at init; read by loop bounds.

fields.name: m_nFirstFree
fields.note: Initialised to 0xFFFFFFFF (-1) = no free slot cached.

fields.name: m_bOwnsMemory
fields.note: Set to 1 at construction — pool owns its m_pObjects/m_byteMap memory.

handle_encoding.validation: byteMap[slot] & 0x80 must be 0 (slot in use) and lower byte of handle must match byteMap[slot]

pools.note: Constructor uses lea eax,[edi+edi*4];shl eax,2 = edi*20. Type TBD. 500 slots. Stored at 0xB7448C (outside the main 0xB74490+ range).
Constructor: imul eax,eax,0x7C4 (0x7C4=1988). CPed VALIDATE_SIZE=0x79C=1948 — the 40-byte gap (0x7C4-0x79C=0x28) is likely per-pool alignment/overflow padding. 140 peds is the hard entity limit.
Constructor: imul eax,eax,0xA18 (0xA18=2584). CAutomobile measured at 0x988=2440 — larger variants (CBike, CPlane, etc.) may drive the 2584 stride. 110 vehicles is the hard vehicle-pool limit.
Constructor: imul eax,eax,0x38 (56). CBuilding is static world geometry — 13000 slots hold all static objects in the currently loaded area. Largest pool by count.
Constructor: imul eax,eax,0x19C (412). CObject stride 0x19C = exactly the CObject VALIDATE_OFFSET-confirmed size. 350 dynamic moveable objects.
2500 slots — likely CDummyObject (static placeholders without full CBuilding overhead) or some model/stream entry. Stride TBD.
10150 slots — matches the SA model-info slot count range (~20000 model IDs but only a subset active). Likely CBaseModelInfo or a streaming slot structure.
64 slots — matches CActiveExplosion pool (documented: 64 slots at 0xC8AC80 in C37). Different global VA; may be a different 64-slot pool.
32 slots. Candidate: CTempNode, CEntryExitManager slot, or similar small pool.
16 slots. Smallest pool. Candidate: CTrainNode, CEntryExit, or similar infrequent object.

memory_notes.heap_pattern: Each pool allocates two malloc blocks: m_pObjects (count*stride bytes) and m_byteMap (count bytes). Total for CPed pool: 140*1988 + 140 = 278,420 bytes ~= 272KB. All 13 pools combined: several MB of static pool memory allocated at game start.
memory_notes.no_runtime_resize: Pool sizes are fixed at creation. The only way to change them is to patch CPools::Initialise before it runs, or hook the constructor calls at 0x5503A0+. Limit Adjuster (community tool) patches the count arguments to these push instructions.
